blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Another playoff exit marred a competitive campaign for Rain or Shine, which fell short on what many consider its best chance of getting into the PBA Finals. Coach Yeng Guiao, whose Elasto Painters were shown the door by the Converge FiberXers on Friday in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals, refused to believe that notion. “You can’t say that Converge and NLEX are weak opponents,” Guiao said with a mixture of Filipino words after Rain or Shine’s 120-109 loss at Smart Araneta Coliseum.
